full_page.content:
Page 134 Mar. 22 Mrs. Mary Grimemis - 39 - inward cancer in blood stream
22 Richard Kuehn - 20 - presbiterian - in Navy Training in Navy - exercise, wrestling with chum - dislocated two vertebrae and is paralyzed from sholders down .... accident hap. Jan. 5th - 11 weeks ago.
Mrs. Eloise Piefle and son - presbiterians - not well - asks for PP. Sam W. McMichael - 73 - Episcop. - officer in draft .... asks for prayers that he succeed and be guided in deferments, etc.
Mar. 24 Mrs. Lucy Otto - 50 - of Saginaw - diabetic - has a son novice in Huntington. Husband anxious for her recovery. She had her First holy Communion at her wedding Mass .... Says when she has troubles or sickness , she offers all for perseverence, etc. of her children. George Soloman - 18 - T. B. in San ....
Kathryn Hunter - 80 0 T.B. Mother of fam ... has been in stitution 3 yrs.
Page 135 Mar. 26 Imeld Rache - 32 - cancer - one breast already removed. Seems very helpless ....
Thadeus Franczak - 17 - unable to talk, save a few short words - gets nervous too - has been enrolled annually for ten years. Today his mother makes it perpetually.
27 Mrs. Mary Jane O'Reilly - 82 - arthritis of spine; never sick before to speak of - finds it hard ....
28 Kay Treglonene - 8 - methodis - inflamation of brain. Parents quite anxious .....
28 Mary Anne Coe - 58 - at Monastery office last night and enrolled her- self and son. He reports she had a heart attack and this a.m.
Emil Danckaert - 61 - serious bladder and ki ...
Mr. & Mrs. Ferc & Rose Miller - he with a stroke two week ago and she in last stages of cancer.
